question: What complete division of the teaching does the seeker wish to know fully?
premises: The seeker desires full knowledge of a division.
The division consists of eight groups of eight.
The desire is to know it thoroughly.
inference: The seeker wishes to know fully the division into eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: The exact sense of anantathā in this context is somewhat unclear.
plain_english: I wish to know fully the division into eight groups of eight.
